schema.about: A UI flow of the DIY Flipper (128x160 screen) as a state machine. states = screens and internal decisions; transitions = what moves from one state to another. Import accepts this file back (Flows > Import). x / y are optional: states without them are laid out on a grid.

state.kind: screen | internal (a firmware decision, no screen)
state.title: string
state.inputMode: screens: normal | list | text (how the firmware treats the buttons on that screen)
state.start: true on the one state the flow starts at
state.end: true on a screen that is meant to have no way out
state.mockup: screens: { id, name, file, template } of the linked asset (export only; import uses mockup.id)

transition.name: free text label (event = same, for older readers)
transition.trigger: null, or { type: 'button', held: null|button, button, gesture } | { type: 'timer', ms } | { type: 'system', event: systemEvents[].id }
transition.transition: { type: cut | slide | push | fade, dir: left|right|up|down (slide/push: where things move), ms, easing: linear|ease-in|ease-out|ease-in-out }

schema.buttons: ok, cancel, left (<), right (>), power. There is no D-pad, no up/down, no touch.
schema.gestures: tap: on press, or on release (before hold_ms) when the same button also has a hold/repeat transition on that screen; hold: once at hold_ms; repeat: at hold_ms, then again faster and faster; release: on release, any duration. held: that button must already be down; when such a combo fires, the held button's own tap/release is skipped.

input.list: < / > move the selection up / down (no need to hold OK); hold Cancel on a list item deletes it
input.text: hold OK switches upper / lower case; hold Cancel cancels the input

source: DIY Flipper Flow Designer (Flipper UI Studio)

states.title: Boot status (POST)
states.note: Self-check like an old PC POST. Ignores buttons except the emergency entry.

states.title: Boot logo + loading
states.note: Shown 1-5 s on purpose (real boot is fast). Earlier note: fade to black before the next screen.

states.title: Enter PIN
states.note: < > turn the digit, OK confirms a digit, Cancel deletes. 6 digits, checked automatically.

states.title: PIN correct?
states.note: 3 wrong tries -> lockout (time stacks, numbers TBD)

states.title: Home Screen
states.note: Only Cancel does something here.

states.title: Launcher
states.note: Long names use marquee when selected.

states.title: Open selected module
states.note: Continues in that module's flow: IR-new, NFC-new, Games-new, WiFi-new, Bluetooth-new, Settings-new

states.title: Emergency code correct?
states.note: Wrong tries count together with the Lock screen counter

transitions.name: Emergency entry
transitions.note: Or a special button combo (not decided yet)

states.title: Launcher (back)
states.note: Leave this flow: back to the Launcher

states.title: Send: categories
states.note: Cancel hold opens the category menu (rename/delete).

states.title: Rename category
states.note: Name already exists -> message, keep editing

states.title: Delete category?
states.note: Deletes every signal inside too; empty category shows "Delete <name>?"

states.title: Signal sent
states.note: Toast + confirm beep, stays on the list

states.title: Learn: waiting
states.note: RMT RX on only while here; timeout ~15 s

transitions.name: OK on the check slot: save
transitions.event: OK on the check slot: save

states.title: NFC Menu
states.note: PN532 starts here; no answer -> "NFC module not found"

states.title: Launcher (back)
states.note: Leave this flow: back to the Launcher

states.title: Emulating
states.note: Idle sleep paused while emulating

states.title: WiFi Menu
states.note: Disconnect row only while connected. WiFi never connects at boot or drops on leaving.

states.title: Launcher (back)
states.note: Leave this flow: back to the Launcher

states.title: Password
states.note: Starts empty. Hold OK switches case.

states.title: Connecting
states.note: Timeout ~15 s

states.title: Connected
states.note: Saves the password now; NTP sync writes time to the DS3231

states.title: Forget network?
states.note: Does not drop the current connection

states.title: BT Menu (waiting)
states.note: Advertising starts here; stops on leaving if nothing is connected

states.title: Launcher (back)
states.note: Leave this flow: back to the Launcher

states.title: Pair request
states.note: Known hosts connect without asking. Bond store full -> oldest removed (LRU)

states.title: Remote groups
states.note: Keys group: arrows, PgUp/PgDn, Esc, Enter (same layout as Media)

states.title: Forget device?
states.note: Forgetting the connected host disconnects it

states.title: Games Menu
states.note: Built-in first, then SD packs. No SD -> toast "SD not available"

states.title: Launcher (back)
states.note: Leave this flow: back to the Launcher

states.title: Game (canvas)
states.note: Full screen, no status bar. Idle dim/sleep off. Level 0: host owns Cancel hold. Levels 1/2 (bypass list) draw their own pause.

states.title: Failsafe exit
states.note: Works at every level; progress bar from 1.5 s

states.title: Launcher (back)
states.note: Leave this flow: back to the Launcher

states.title: Display: editing
states.note: < > adjust, hold to speed up

states.title: Power
states.note: Sleep after hides when Never is chosen; numbers edit in the row like T1e

states.title: Sound
states.note: Toggles flip on OK; Volume edits in the row

states.title: Current PIN correct?
states.note: Wrong tries count with the Lock screen counter

states.title: Lock message
states.note: Can be empty; length limit TBD

states.title: Editing time
states.note: OK moves to the next field

states.title: Emergency code
states.note: Always required, every scope

states.title: Code correct?
states.note: Wrong tries count with the Lock screen counter

states.title: Reset the chosen scope and reboot
states.note: SD files are kept
